findings.reason: Lines 126-129 run git symbolic-ref in process.cwd(), and line 135 exits 0 on main/master. tool_input.to is only regex-tested for 'implement' (line 104) and is never mapped to a branch. dev-team-task/SKILL.md:154 has Drucker spawn one implementer per issue, each on its own feat/ branch. findings.claim: The guard checks the sender's (lead's) current branch, not the target implementer's branch, so the lead on main can shut down unreviewed implementers.
findings.evidence: Lines 126-129 run `git symbolic-ref --short HEAD` in process.cwd(), which is the lead's checkout. findings.reason: Line 26 reads process.argv[2], and settings.json invokes the hook with no arguments. But all 11 existing hooks (merge-gate.js:36, review-gate.js:34, safety-guard.js:20, ...) use the same pattern, so this follows a convention the change didn't introduce, and the repo can't show how the hooks are really invoked. I lowered it from high to medium: if the claim holds, the whole hook set fails the same way, not just this change.
findings.claim: The hook reads input from argv[2], but Claude Code passes hook events on stdin, so the installed hook never enforces anything.
findings.evidence: templates/settings.json invokes the script without arguments, but line 26 reads only process.argv[2]. Claude Code supplies command-hook events through stdin ([hook reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#hook-input-and-output)). Supplying a SendMessage shutdown event on stdin returned exit 0: input becomes {}, and the tool-name check exits before enforcement. The new tests pass JSON as an argument, masking this integration failure.

findings.reason: Line 90 uses message.includes("shutdown_request") and line 97 tests /--force-shutdown/i on that same model-written text. The only record of a bypass is a console.warn.
findings.claim: Any string message that contains 'shutdown_request' is treated as a shutdown, and the model writing the message can add --force-shutdown to bypass the guard.

Line 97 is `/--force-shutdown/i.test(messageStr)` on the same model-authored text, so the lead agent can bypass the guard by adding the flag. The only record is a console.warn.
